items.title: Bank of America Sets 12-Month S&P 500 Target at 7,800, Sees 2% Upside
items.summary: Bank of America (BofA) has introduced a 12-month target of 7,800 for the S&P 500, implying approximately 2% upside from current levels, while raising its year-end forecast and identifying several risks to US equities. In a note published this week, strategist Savita Subramanian increased the bank’s year-end target to 7,400 from 7,100.

items.title: Sodexo (ENXTPA:SW) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump After Analyst Target Increases
items.summary: Sodexo’s fair value estimate has shifted from €52.66 to €54.63, a change of about 3.7% that fine tunes where analysts see the stock’s long term potential. This sits alongside a series of upward price target moves from more positive houses, even as others keep Neutral or Underweight ratings and cluster in the €50 to €60 range.
